report: Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Humans
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: AI leaves most people better off
entries.quote: By 2030, do you think it is most likely that advancing AI and related technology systems will enhance human capacities and empower them? That is, most of the time, will most people be better off than they are today? Or is it most likely that advancing AI and related technology systems will lessen human autonomy and agency to such an extent that most people will not be better off [...]?
entries.subject: AI and human well-being
entries.note: The report says 63% are 'hopeful' that most individuals will be better off in 2030.
entries.answer_mapping: agree = most people better off in 2030; disagree = not better off

notes: One closed question from a non-random opt-in canvassing, followed by open-ended elaboration (not captured). Pew calls the results nonscientific and not projectable.
